Classic Beef Chli

This recipe is a classic one. Added to the website by yours truly, the Adminstrator. May it serve you well.
Feel free to repost this anywhere you want. I don't take credit for this recipe. I stole it from someone else, but that person is no longer with us.

Ingredients
Olive oil (1-2 tbsp)
1 medium yellow onion, diced
2 garlic cloves, minced
2 pounds ground beef (80% lean recommended)
2 cans (15 oz each) of kidney beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 can (6 oz) tomato paste
1 cup beef or chicken broth
Spices: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and a pinch of cayenne
Salt and black pepper to taste
Optional toppings: sour cream, shredded cheese, or green onions
Instructions
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onions until translucent, then add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add ground beef, breaking it apart while cooking, until browned.
Stir in tomato paste and spices. Cook until fragrant (about 1-2 minutes).
Add beans, crushed tomatoes, and broth. Simmer uncovered for 30-40 minutes until thickened.

White Chicken Chili
Submited by my dear friend, Susan. While this recipe is great I have yet to achieve the same flavour as she did. 
I think there's a secret to her way of cooking it that I've yet to discover...

Ingredients
Olive oil (2 tbsp)
1 small onion, diced
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 can (4 oz) diced green chiles
2 cups cooked shredded chicken (rotisserie works great!)
2 cans (15 oz each) white beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) chicken broth
1 cup heavy cream (or half-and-half for less richness)
Spices: 1 tsp cumin, half tsp chili powder, half tsp oregano
Optional toppings: avocado slices, fresh cilantro, lime wedges

Instructions
Heat oil in a pot over medium heat. Sauté onions and garlic until soft.
Stir in green chiles and spices. Cook briefly to bloom the flavors.
Add chicken, beans, and broth. Bring to a simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream, simmering gently for another 5-10 minutes.
Serve with toppings for added flavor and texture.
